subject: Weight least square fitting function for multilevel ordinal CFA

messages.author: 2368ae49227cd233
messages.subject: Weight least square fitting function for multilevel ordinal CFA
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to get a solid understanding of how a multilevel ordinal CFA gets fit to the sample data. My question is, what does the WLS fitting function look like for this multilevel scheme used in lavaan? I couldn't find any article elaborating on this issue with respect to ordinal data but of course I am there must be a few out there.

My speculation is that polychoric correlation matrix is estimated for each cluster. Subsequently, WLS fitting function for each cluster can be constructed. The goal is to minimize the sum of fitting functions derived from all clusters. Is my speculation correct? Thank you very much.

Best,
Chao

On 05/31/2018 09:17 PM, Chao Xu wrote:
> Hi all,
>
> I am trying to get a solid understanding of how a multilevel ordinal
> CFA gets fit to the sample data.

This is NOT supported by 0.6-1, which only handles continuous data in
the multilevel setting.

> My question is, what does the WLS
> fitting function look like for this multilevel scheme used in lavaan?

See this document:

www.statmodel.com/download/p2t1.pdf

As far as I know, there is no further literature on this (using WLS in
long format).

Yves.
